label: NIWA and partners publish Hokianga and Western Kaipara crop maps
summary: A 35-map inventory of climate and soil information screened potential for ten crops across western Kaipara and Hokianga. Kaipara and Far North councils distributed the results through local libraries and council offices.

sources.label: Griffiths et al., Use of Climate, Soil, and Crop Information for Identifying Potential Land-Use Change in the Hokianga and Western Kaipara Region, NIWA Client Report AKL2003-037, March 2003
